Akshaya Tritiya sadya — Friday May 19

We're putting out a full banana-leaf sadya for Akshaya Tritiya. Eighteen items on the leaf, payasam included, the rice mound at the center, the way amma used to set it down.

=== On the leaf this year ===
- Rice + sambar + rasam + curd
- Avial · Kerala-style mixed vegetable in coconut
- Olan · ash gourd + cowpea + coconut milk
- Thoran (cabbage) · pachadi · kichadi
- Parippu + ghee · pappadam · banana chips
- Mango pickle · ginger pickle · two chutneys
- Palada pradhaman as the closer

=== Two seatings, pre-book only ===
12pm and 2pm. Thirty plates per seating. $24 a plate.

Once it's full, we close the list — we cook for the seating, not for walk-ins. The kitchen is one tava and one team; this is the only way the sadya goes out the way it should.

Call to reserve: (703) 555-0142

Aditi's Kitchen · 43880 Russell Branch Pkwy, Ashburn VA 20147 · Tue–Sun 11am–9pm
